result.summary: The environment features a narrow street with a sidewalk that is partially obstructed by street furniture and utility equipment. There is a lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or signals, which increases risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A traffic cone, planter, and fire hydrant narrow the usable walking space on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left and center

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, unobstructed path of travel by relocating or better organizing street furniture.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Remove parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of basic crossing infrastructure at a residential intersection. While sidewalks are present, there are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices to facilitate safe pedestrian movement across the roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted markings to designate a pedestrian crossing area or alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Inaccessible Curb
hazards.description: There are no curb ramps visible, creating a physical barrier for individuals with mobility aids, strollers, or carts.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner of the sidewalk adjacent to the brick building.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner obstruct the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Silver car parked on the left side near the intersection corner.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct detectable warning surface curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a sidewalk adjacent to a mixed-use building but lacks basic safety infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals, and utility poles at the corner may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps at the corner, creating accessibility barriers for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in front of the grey building

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles located at the corner may partially block sightlines between turning vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking any formal sidewalk or protective infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to navigate a narrow roadway or an uneven, degraded apron area that is obstructed by planters and debris.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: No dedicated sidewalk exists, forcing pedestrians to share the narrow roadway with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire street frontage along the buildings.

hazards.name: Degraded and Uneven Surfaces
hazards.description: The pavement in the pedestrian path is cracked, crumbling, and contains dirt patches, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground in front of the white building.

hazards.name: Absence of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, which creates a high-risk environment for pedestrians during low-light conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible street corridor.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, raised, and ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a safe and separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway and pedestrian areas to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.
